NGA.note: The article states no rule or authority on AI harms.
Only a customs system with claimed AI features is described, which is sector management, not general administration.
The article says B'Odogwu has AI and machine learning capabilities but gives no AI output or use in service.
No locally built AI model, dataset or AI computing is stated.

facts.fact: The Nigeria Customs Service has introduced the web-based B'Odogwu Unified Customs Management System, and its PTML Command recorded a record N44.9 billion monthly revenue in November 2024, per the service's deputy comptroller-general Kikelomo Adeola.

NGA.note: The article names no national standards body membership, adopted standard or rule; the WCO SAFE Framework is not an IT standard.
The article concerns customs revenue, not tax filing or payment.
